description: This file defines the SecurityFactory class which provides a singleton pattern for obtaining Security instances, including a default implementation (OFBizSecurity) that manages security permissions, roles, and user data within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SecurityFactory
classes.description: A factory class for obtaining Security instances, with a default internal implementation.

classes.name: OFBizSecurity
classes.description: Default implementation of the Security interface, managing permissions, roles, and user data within OFBiz.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a Security instance, using ServiceLoader to find custom implementations or defaulting to OFBizSecurity.

methods.name: clearUserData
methods.description: Removes user-specific security data from cache.

methods.name: findUserLoginSecurityGroupByUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves security groups for a user login ID (deprecated).

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the delegator associated with the security instance (deprecated).

methods.name: hasEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission for an entity action.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific permission.

methods.name: hasRolePermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific role permission, including application and action context.

methods.name: securityGroupPermissionExists
methods.description: Checks if a security group permission exists (deprecated).

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator for the security instance (deprecated).
